chunks: So, those who believed and did good things will be admitted to His favour by their Lord. This will be a clear triumph.
ai.seo_question: What is the condition for entering God's mercy and achieving clear triumph according to this verse?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the inseparable link between *iman* (faith) and *amal* (righteous action), where divine mercy is the ultimate reward for those who actualize their belief through deeds. The term *al-fawz al-mubin* (clear triumph) is interpreted not merely as entry into Paradise, but as the visible realization of spiritual success in both this world and the hereafter, distinguishing true believers from those who claim faith without practice.
